metadata.title: Seera — Build an ATS-friendly resume
metadata.description: Create your resume in Arabic or English with clear, example-guided steps, and pass applicant tracking systems with confidence.

marketing.title: A resume that passes ATS
marketing.subtitle: Every field comes with a ready example, in Arabic and English, no guide required.

features.title: ATS-compatible by design
features.description: A single-column template with no images or tables, parsed correctly by any applicant tracking system.

features.title: Arabic and English
features.description: Build a complete resume in both languages, and export each with one click.

features.title: Every field has an example
features.description: No guide needed — every field comes with a ready example you can use or edit.

features.title: Instant ATS score
features.description: See your score out of 100 as soon as you fill in your data, with a clear list of what to fix.

steps.title: Sign up with your email
steps.description: No password — we send you a one-time login code.

steps.title: Fill in your details step by step
steps.description: 9 clear steps, each field with a ready example and a live preview of your resume.

steps.title: Export a ready PDF
steps.description: In Arabic or English, formatted to pass ATS systems directly.

review.subtitle: Review your resume, then print it in Arabic or English.

review.pdfHint: Generates a clean PDF on the server with a download link valid for 15 minutes.

exit.title: Leave the builder?
exit.description: Your data is saved automatically as you type, and you can come back to finish this resume later from the dashboard — it stays a draft until you complete and export it. Only what you typed in the last second or two is not saved yet: choose "Save and leave" to keep it, or "Discard" to leave without it.

ats.title: ATS Compatibility Score
ats.jobPostingPlaceholder: Paste the job description you're applying to, to match keywords

issues.personalIncomplete: Complete all required personal information fields
issues.experienceEmpty: Add at least one work experience entry
issues.educationEmpty: Add at least one education entry
issues.skillsEmpty: Add at least one skill category
issues.dateOrderInvalid: Check your experience dates — the end date must be after the start date
issues.unexplainedGap: You have an unexplained gap longer than 6 months between two jobs
issues.notNewestFirst: Order your experience from most recent to oldest
issues.weakVerbs: Start achievement bullets with strong past-tense verbs (Developed, Led, Improved...)
issues.missingNumbers: Add numbers showing a measurable result in at least half your bullets
issues.bulletLength: Keep each bullet between 8 and 30 words
issues.weakPhrasesOrFirstPerson: Avoid phrases like "responsible for" and first-person pronouns
issues.missingKeywords: Some keywords from the job posting are missing from your resume
issues.emojiOrSymbols: Remove emoji or decorative symbols from your resume
issues.easternDigits: Use Latin numerals (0-9) instead of Eastern Arabic-Indic digits
issues.phoneFormat: Write your phone number in international format (e.g. +966 5X XXX XXXX)
